amount_text: Maximum potential liability ~$43B undiscounted once all racks are deployed (Broadcom 8-K): 72.5% of outstanding lease amounts minus the racks' sale value. Supports the $63B financing (separate edges for the bank first lien and Blackstone second lien); this replaces the earlier reported 'up to $42B' Broadcom financing commitment
term: Falls as Anthropic pays its leases; deliveries from 2027
title_en: Broadcom backs Anthropic chip-lease financing with up to $43B residual value support
title_zh: 博通为 Anthropic 芯片租赁融资提供最高 430 亿美元余值担保支持
summary_en: On 26 October 2026 Broadcom agreed to give residual value support to a newly formed backstop vehicle in the $63B financing of Broadcom AI racks leased to Anthropic (the obligor); if Anthropic defaults, Broadcom covers the gap between 72.5% of the lease balance and what the racks fetch, up to ~$43B. Earlier reports (1 October) described this as Broadcom lending Anthropic up to $42B with the right to designate financing partners.
summary_zh: 2026 年 10 月 26 日，博通同意在为 Anthropic（付款义务人）租赁博通 AI 机架而安排的 630 亿美元融资中，向新设立的兜底实体提供余值担保支持：若 Anthropic 违约，博通补足租赁余额的 72.5% 与机架处置价值之间的差额，最高约 430 亿美元。10 月 1 日的早期报道称博通将向 Anthropic 提供最高 420 亿美元融资并可指定融资伙伴。

amount_text: Up to $105B (WSJ had reported talks of ~$250B); OpenAI must reimburse Nvidia for any payout
title_en: Nvidia guarantees up to $105B of OpenAI's Ohio lease payments to SB Energy
title_zh: 英伟达为 OpenAI 向 SB Energy 支付的俄亥俄园区租金提供最高 1050 亿美元担保
summary_en: Nvidia guaranteed up to $105B of OpenAI's lease and power payments to SoftBank's SB Energy for the PORTS-Pike campus in Piketon, Ohio (initially 4.25 GW from 2028), payable only if OpenAI defaults; OpenAI is the obligor. Nvidia is also investing $1.5B in SB Energy.
summary_zh: 英伟达为 OpenAI 向软银旗下 SB Energy 租用俄亥俄州派克顿 PORTS-Pike 园区（2028 年起首期 4.25 吉瓦）应付的租金和电费提供最高 1050 亿美元担保，仅在 OpenAI 违约时触发，付款义务人为 OpenAI；英伟达另向 SB Energy 投资 15 亿美元。

to_name: AI XPV (Broadcom chip-lease SPV for Anthropic)
amount_text: Maximum exposure $29B; rises as racks are deployed and falls as the customer pays its 5-year leases
title_en: Broadcom backstops up to $29B of lease payments to its AI XPV SPV
title_zh: 博通为其 AI XPV 特殊目的实体的租金提供最高 290 亿美元兜底
summary_en: When Apollo took over the purchase of Broadcom-designed AI racks and their leases to a customer (reported to be Anthropic, the obligor), Broadcom agreed to backstop the customer's 5-year lease payments, with a maximum exposure of $29B.
summary_zh: 阿波罗接手博通设计的 AI 机架采购及其对客户的租赁合同（据报道客户为 Anthropic，即被担保债务人）时，博通同意为该客户 5 年期租金提供兜底，最高敞口 290 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; covers Fluidstack's lease payments and pass-through obligations for the 15-year base term ($7.0B lease)
title_en: Google backstops Fluidstack's River Bend lease with Hut 8
title_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 在 Hut 8 River Bend 的租约提供兜底
summary_en: Google provides a financial backstop covering Fluidstack's lease payments and pass-through obligations to Hut 8 at River Bend for the 15-year base term (Fluidstack is the obligor), which supports Hut 8's project financing.
summary_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 在 River Bend 园区 15 年基础租期内应付 Hut 8 的租金及转嫁费用提供财务兜底（付款义务人为 Fluidstack），为 Hut 8 的项目融资提供支撑。

amount_text: Google backs ~$1.3B of Fluidstack's long-term lease obligations at the Abernathy JV campus; no TeraWulf warrants issued
title_en: Google backstops $1.3B of Fluidstack's Abernathy lease
title_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 的 Abernathy 租约提供 13 亿美元兜底
summary_en: Google agreed to back about $1.3 billion of Fluidstack's lease payments (Fluidstack is the obligor) to the TeraWulf–Fluidstack joint venture's Abernathy, Texas campus, to support the project's debt financing; unlike the Lake Mariner backstop, no TeraWulf warrants were issued.
summary_zh: 谷歌同意为 Fluidstack 向 TeraWulf–Fluidstack 合资公司得州 Abernathy 园区支付的约 13 亿美元租金提供兜底（付款义务人为 Fluidstack），以支持项目债务融资；与 Lake Mariner 兜底不同，此次 TeraWulf 未发行认股权证。

amount_text: Undisclosed; covers the first 16 years of operations
title_en: Meta residual value guarantee to Hyperion JV
title_zh: Meta 向 Hyperion 合资公司提供余值担保
summary_en: Meta gave the Hyperion joint venture a residual value guarantee: if Meta stops leasing and the campus is worth less than what bondholders and Blue Owl are owed, Meta pays the difference. S&P warned that substantial credit risk could pass back to Meta.
summary_zh: Meta 向 Hyperion 合资公司提供余值担保：若 Meta 不再续租且园区价值低于欠债券持有人和 Blue Owl 的金额，由 Meta 补足差额。标普警告称，大量信用风险可能回流至 Meta。

amount_text: $1.73B total: $1.4B (Sept 2025) + $333M (Nov 2025); Google receives warrants for ~5.4% of Cipher
title_en: Google backstops $1.73B of Fluidstack leases at Cipher
title_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 在 Cipher 的租约提供 17.3 亿美元兜底
summary_en: Google backstopped Fluidstack's lease payments to Cipher Mining's Barber Lake, Texas site (Fluidstack is the obligor), first $1.4B and then a further $333M when the lease grew to the full 300 MW site, supporting Cipher's project bonds.
summary_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 向 Cipher Mining 得州 Barber Lake 园区支付的租金提供兜底（付款义务人为 Fluidstack），先为 14 亿美元，租约扩至整个 300 兆瓦园区后再增加 3.33 亿美元，以支持 Cipher 的项目债券。

amount_text: $3.2B total: $1.8B (CB-3/CB-4, Aug 14) + $1.4B (CB-5, Aug 18); Google receives warrants for ~14% of TeraWulf
title_en: Google backstops $3.2B of Fluidstack leases at TeraWulf
title_zh: 谷歌为 Fluidstack 在 TeraWulf 的租约提供 32 亿美元兜底
summary_en: Google agreed to cover up to $3.2B of Fluidstack's lease payments to TeraWulf's Lake Mariner campus if Fluidstack cannot pay (Fluidstack is the obligor), which let TeraWulf raise project debt; in return Google got warrants making it TeraWulf's largest shareholder.
summary_zh: 谷歌同意在 Fluidstack 无法支付时，承担其对 TeraWulf 纽约 Lake Mariner 园区最高 32 亿美元的租金（付款义务人为 Fluidstack），使 TeraWulf 得以进行项目债务融资；作为回报谷歌获得认股权证，成为 TeraWulf 最大股东。
